Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.
Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.
The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.
This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end-system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.
Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity , we will give your application fair consideration.

As a software engineer on the OpenStack Engineering team, you'll be building Charmed OpenStack and Ceph, a suite of open source Python based charms for deploying and managing OpenStack and Ceph. Your work will bring cloud platform technologies to a wide range of users and computing environments, from desktops to bare metal servers. This role requires a python software developer with a passion for automating infrastructure as code.
Applicants should be passionate about the future of the software defined datacenter, distributed systems, and open source. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.
This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.

  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions

  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events

  • Education and courses stipend

title: Geotechnical Engineer – Junior/Mid Level
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for a Geotechnical Engineer to join our Rio de Janeiro office. As part of the Geotechnical Group, the Geotechnical Engineer assesses and analyzes the ground on which buildings and other structures will be erected; examine soil, check underground water flow, and conduct other tests to ensure the stability of an area before construction begins.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbours, and rivers. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 in Marine and Port Facilities and among the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Examines the sites of proposed buildings or other structures, such as dams or tunnels, or those to be used for drilling or mining projects, to check soil stability and rock formations
  • Confirms the safety and durability of surfaces for building projects, design structural foundations, and conduct environmental testing
  • Conducts tests on items in a laboratory. They study properties, note any contaminations or other issues, and produce reports about their findings for project managers
  • Study safety quality standards for different projects and make sure that each project adheres to these standards
  • Inspects foundations, observing drilling activities, and reviewing work plans are some of the ways geotechnical engineers ensure adherence to these standards
  • Present possible project risks, explain seismic activities, make recommendations for foundations and excavation activities, and summarize the progress of individual projects
  • Perform geostructural analysis and design of waterfront structures, including bulkheads, deep foundations, retaining walls, and flood control structures
  • Interpret field test data (SPT, sCPT, FVST, DMT) and estimate soil engineering properties for design
  • Assigns lab tests and interpret results
  • Estimates deep foundation lateral and axial capacities
  • Designs bulkheads, retaining walls, and floodwalls
  • Designs wall structural components, including wales, tierods, tiebacks, cap beams, etc.
  • Develops plans and specifications
  • Help resolve design problems that may include performing field investigation or inspections, detailed design work, and detailed checking of design computations done by others, or general coordination of specific design aspects into a project
  • Calculates construction quantity estimates
  • Works closely with other architects, engineers, scientists, project managers, etc. on multi-discipline projects
  • Performs office-based construction administration including review of shop drawings and technical submittals
  • Performs construction site inspections and prepare inspection reports

Other duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or relevant experience
  • 4+ years of experience
  • Professional Engineer licensure in Brazil (CREA)
  • Experience using and proficiency with the following geotechnical software package categories:
    • Lateral pile analysis (ie: LPile, AllPile)
    • Axial pile/drilled shaft analysis (ie: APile, AllPile, Driven, Shaft)
    • Pile group analysis (ie: Group, AllPile)
    • Slope stability (ie: Slope, Slide)
    • Excavation support (ie: DeepEX, WALLAP, Support-IT, CT Shoring Suite)
    • Finite element analysis (ie: Plaxis)
    • Settlement (ie: Settle3, FoSSA, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of ACI, AISC, AASHTO, IBC, NDS, and other design codes
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and AutoCAD. Experience in Civil3D a plus
  • Experience with structural analysis software (SAP, STAAD) a plus
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Physical requirements:

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Moffatt & Nichol’s EEO Statement:

As a global business, Moffatt & Nichol relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical Solutions serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all activities. We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. This approach enables us to better understand and serve our clients, foster innovation, and create a rich, collaborative work environment. Moffatt & Nichol is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity / Federal Contractor desiring priority referrals of all protected veterans for job openings.

A Diaverum é a empresa líder a nível internacional na prestação de cuidados renais, com foco em melhorar a vida renal dos pacientes - permitindo-lhes viver uma vida plena. A nossa experiência em cuidados renais remonta há mais de 25 anos e temos estado na vanguarda do setor desde então. As nossas operações abrangem atualmente 24 países, com mais de 14.000 funcionários motivados que atendem uma base de pacientes de mais de 40.000 indivíduos.

Atividades:

  1. Fornece terapia de diálise crônica, incluindo, mas não se limitando à formulação de um plano de diálise com ultra filtração, iniciando a diálise através de vários acessos, cumprindo as medidas de segurança e monitorando os sinais vitais do paciente aplicáveis aos pacientes com insuficiência renal crônica de acordo com o Plano de Cuidados.
  2. Prepara e administra medicamentos, fluido terapia ou outros tratamentos apropriados por prescrição médica e realiza as respectivas documentações no prontuário do paciente.
  3. Analisa dados do paciente; avalia e monitoriza o status dos acessos vasculares, revisa resultados laboratoriais, avaliações de pacientes e relata quaisquer alterações ou anormalidades relevantes ao médico plantonista.
  4. Monitoriza o sistema de tratamento de água de diálise para uso de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  5. Montar e verificar o funcionamento dos aparelhos de hemodiálise, garantindo que todos os dispositivos estejam limpos, funcionais e calibrados.
  6. Avaliar as condições clínicas do paciente antes e após a sessão, incluindo sinais vitais e acesso vascular.
  7. Observar continuamente os sinais vitais e os parâmetros do aparelho durante a hemodiálise para garantir a eficácia e a segurança do tratamento, ajustar o fluxo sanguíneo e os parâmetros da máquina conforme necessário.
  8. Realizar uma avaliação inicial detalhada, coletando informações sobre sintomas, histórico médico e alterações recentes no estado de saúde.
  9. Inspecionar e cuidar do acesso vascular para prevenir infecções e complicações, instruir o paciente sobre cuidados domiciliares com o acesso.
  10. Manter registros detalhados sobre o tratamento, incluindo dados vitais, parâmetros da máquina, e qualquer evento adverso. Assegurar que a documentação seja completa e precisa.
  11. Relatar alterações no estado do paciente e resultados das sessões à equipe médica e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos no cuidado.
  12. Assegurar que todos os procedimentos sejam realizados de acordo com as normas e protocolos estabelecidos pela Diaverum Brasil.
  13. Fornece educação continuada ao paciente e respectivo prestador de cuidados.
  14. Participa proativamente em programas de melhoria de qualidade.

Requisitos:

  1. Graduação em Enfermagem;
  2. Registro no COREN;
  3. Experiência em procedimentos hospitalares e Hemodiálise;
  4. Especialização em Nefrologia (desejável).

Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender às necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia.

Fundada em Vitória (ES), a empresa já conta com mais de 35 milhões de clientes ativos e faz parte do grupo J&F, um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do Brasil. A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop.

Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.

O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.

Sobre a vaga:

Somos o time que apoia a alta liderança e diversas unidades de negócio do PicPay com análises estratégicas de mercado, concorrência e tendências.

Atuamos de forma transversal, com visão ampla de produtos e negócios, sempre com foco em gerar insights acionáveis e suportar decisões críticas com dados e contexto.

Aqui, você terá a chance de influenciar diretamente os rumos da empresa, combinando visão analítica, mentalidade estratégica e proximidade com os principais decisores.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  1. Análises estratégicas e estudos de mercado: produzir reports robustos sobre concorrência, tendências e oportunidades, com foco em gerar recomendações claras para os stakeholders.
  2. Modelagem de TAM (Total Addressable Market): apoiar a construção e revisão de modelos de mercado para os produtos atuais e potenciais do PicPay.
  3. Construção de apresentações executivas: transformar dados internos do PicPay e públicos em análises estruturadas, com insights estratégicos e recomendações para a liderança.
  4. Interlocução com a liderança: participar ativamente de discussões com times de negócio e C-levels, trazendo uma perspectiva externa e orientada a dados.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  1. Experiência prévia em consultorias estratégicas ou áreas de inteligência/planejamento em bancos, fintechs ou adquirentes;
  2. Capacidade analítica sólida, pensamento estruturado e visão estratégica de negócios;
  3. Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;
  4. Domínio de Excel e PowerPoint;
  5. Conhecimentos de finanças corporativas (interpretação de DRE, BP, FC, elaboração de business plans) são um diferencial;
  6. Conhecimento de linguagem de banco de dados/programação para manipulação e extração de dados (SQL, Python, R);
  7. Inglês avançado;
  8. Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em São Paulo – Capital.

O que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;
  • Wellhub.
  • Alimentação/Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho: Cartão de crédito PicPay Benefícios, com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho).
  • Licença Paternidade e Maternidade: Licença Maternidade estendida de 6 meses, e de Paternidade também estendida de 20 dias.
  • Programa "Novo Ser", que acompanha nossas mamães durante toda a gestação e no retorno da licença. Ao retornar, as mamães ainda contam com a ajuda do Auxílio Creche e também os papais que possuem guarda unilateral ou compartilhada.
  • Reconhecemos resultados: Participação nos Resultados do PicPay (PPR).

title: Distribution Industrial Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Distribution Industrial Engineer role at QVC

Thank you for your interest in joining our team! QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands – QVC, HSN, Ballard Designs, Frontgate, Garnet Hill, and Grandin Road. We are a live social shopping company that redefines the shopping experience through video-driven commerce on every screen, from smartphones and tablets to laptops and TVs.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Industrial Engineer to lead process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives within our high-volume Bethlehem, PA fulfillment center. The ideal candidate will leverage data-driven methodologies, lean principles, and advanced engineering techniques to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels.

You will also manage capital projects and network-level, multi-facility projects. You will be highly visible to all levels of the organization and lead and be a key contributor to some of the company’s highest-value efforts. You will have ample responsibility and authority to do great things for the organization. We hire both for current aptitude and future potential; we will support your career development.

You will report to the Senior Manager of Process Engineering and Operational Excellence and frequently interact with many business functions, internal and external to the Bethlehem Site. Some travel is necessary and will fluctuate between 15 – 30%. We have a great team and look forward to you joining us!

Your Impact

  1. Process Optimization: Analyze and improve warehouse workflows, material handling systems, and labor utilization to maximize throughput and minimize waste.
  2. Data Analysis & Modeling: Use simulation tools, time studies, and statistical analysis to identify performance gaps and recommend solutions.
  3. Project Leadership: Lead cross-functional projects from concept through implementation, including layout redesigns, automation integration, and system upgrades.
  4. Performance Metrics: Develop and monitor KPIs to track productivity, quality, and cost performance. Provide actionable insights to operations leadership.
  5. Technology Integration: Evaluate and implement new technologies such as robotics, conveyor systems, and warehouse management systems (WMS).
  6. Standard Work & SOPs: Create and maintain standard operating procedures and best practices to ensure consistency and compliance.
  7. Training & Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to operations staff on industrial engineering tools and techniques.
  8. Safety & Ergonomics: Collaborate with safety teams to design ergonomic workstations and ensure compliance with safety standards.

What You Bring

  1. 5+ years of industrial engineering experience.
  2. 3+ years in high-volume warehousing environment (distribution or fulfillment).
  3. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research or related discipline is required.
  4. Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies. Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is a plus.
  5. Proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, Power BI) and simulation and modeling software (AutoCAD, FlexSim, etc.).
  6. Experience with WMS, ERP, and automation systems.
  7. Excellent communication, leadership, and project management skills.
  8. Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities.
  9. Maynard Operational Sequence Technique (MOST) Certified.
  10. Project Management Experience leading large-scale projects.
  11. Experience with robotics and automation in warehouse settings.
  12. Familiarity with labor management systems (LMS) and engineered labor standards.

If you enjoy being a part of a team, creating experiences, and delighting customers, you’ll love it here. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package including competitive compensation, health care benefits starting on day 1, 401(k), paid time off, tuition reimbursement, employee assistance program, parental leave, paid volunteer hours, company discounts, and more. We are committed to inclusion and belonging for all, providing equal employment opportunities and accommodations as needed.

Fazemos painéis solares, baterias, chassis de ônibus elétricos e em breve automóveis híbridos plug-in e elétricos na fábrica de Camaçari, Bahia. Também comercializamos automóveis, caminhões, furgões, máscaras descartáveis e empilhadeiras elétricas, além de um projeto de Skyrail em São Paulo para a Linha 17 – Ouro do Metrô.

Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência - Estágio e Efetivo - Associado de Consultoria

ASAP está comprometida com a inclusão, diversidade e equidade, utilizando a tecnologia para impulsionar a inovação e a competitividade em toda a sociedade. Como líder global em software empresarial, a SAP ajuda organizações a enfrentar desafios com eficiência e produtividade. A empresa valoriza habilidades diversas e busca criar um ambiente de trabalho equitativo e inclusivo, onde os colaboradores possam crescer e alcançar o sucesso.

Este programa convida pessoas que se identificam como pessoas com deficiência e/ou neurodivergentes a se juntarem à SAP, candidatando-se a esta oportunidade. A inscrição não impede os candidatos de explorarem outras oportunidades dentro da SAP.

Se precisar de alguma adaptação específica ou assistência especial para o seu sucesso durante o processo de entrevista, informe-nos com antecedência. Envie um e-mail com sua solicitação para a equipe de Operações de Recrutamento:

Visão Geral

Associado de Consultoria em Processos de Negócios desempenha um papel fundamental na tradução da visão dos clientes em soluções inovadoras e práticas. Ele apoia o mapeamento de processos de negócios e requisitos de soluções, auxiliando na transformação para a Empresa Inteligente, aplicando melhores práticas, metodologias avançadas e padrões SAP.

Essa função envolve o design e a configuração de soluções SAP, tanto on-premise, em nuvem ou híbridas, para diferentes setores e linhas de negócios.

Esse profissional apoia projetos de consultoria por meio de atividades como suporte, revisão de soluções, resolução de problemas e envolvimento em projetos conduzidos por parceiros. Além disso, apresenta as melhores práticas da SAP e do setor, conduz treinamentos para equipes de clientes e documenta os serviços prestados. Seu trabalho garante implementações bem-sucedidas do portfólio de serviços da SAP, apoiando testes de solução e resolução de problemas.

Principais Responsabilidades e Tarefas

Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Processos de Negócios:

  • Criar e implementar processos detalhados, incentivando a inovação e padronizando os serviços oferecidos.
  • Projetar processos específicos para diferentes setores ou empresas, garantindo alinhamento com as melhores práticas e a estratégia de Empresa Inteligente da SAP.
  • Identificar serviços empresariais essenciais e recomendar soluções SAP e de terceiros, garantindo sua integração com os processos, aplicações e o ambiente de TI do cliente.
  • Avaliar tendências de mercado e tecnologia, desenvolvendo mapas de processos e soluções por setor.
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico do portfólio interno e fortalecer as ofertas de serviços específicas para cada setor.
  • Mapear processos de negócios para a arquitetura de TI da empresa, garantindo uma integração eficiente no ambiente tecnológico.
  • Definir requisitos para customizações e integrações, quando as soluções padrão não forem suficientes.
  • Realizar revisões de processos e sistemas, assegurando alinhamento e eficiência operacional.
  • Apoiar a definição de estruturas organizacionais, indicadores de desempenho e métricas-chave, junto ao Gerente de Transformação.
  • Implementar novos processos, otimizando as funções empresariais dos clientes.

Requisitos de Experiência e Educação

  • Experiência: Não é necessária experiência prévia, porém experiências anteriores em áreas relacionadas (experiência funcional com qualquer módulo ou solução SAP, com conhecimento da Intelligent Enterprise Suite e seus processos end-to-end) serão um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado e conhecimento de outros idiomas adicionais são um diferencial.
  • Formação: Curso técnico ou graduação (concluída ou em andamento) em Administração de Empresas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas afins. Certificações ou formação técnica em áreas especializadas também são valorizadas.

Competências Essenciais

  • Pensamento Analítico: Capacidade de compreender processos de negócios complexos e transformá-los em soluções eficientes, utilizando as melhores práticas da SAP.
  • Adaptabilidade: Flexibilidade para trabalhar com diferentes módulos SAP e atender às diversas necessidades empresariais de cada setor.
  • Foco no Cliente: Forte orientação para entender e atender às necessidades do cliente, promovendo um relacionamento de confiança e sucesso.
  • Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar soluções de forma clara, conduzir treinamentos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Abordagem criativa para solucionar desafios específicos dos clientes, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções otimizadas.

Na SAP, estamos comprometidos com a inovação, diversidade e crescimento pessoal e profissional, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo em diferentes culturas e países. Como líder global em software empresarial, nossa missão é tornar o mundo melhor e melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Junte-se ao nosso time, onde você fará parte de um ambiente vibrante e colaborativo, ajudando os clientes a terem sucesso com as soluções SAP.

Animado para começar sua jornada na SAP? Candidate-se hoje com seu currículo em inglês e traga sua autenticidade para a nossa equipe!

Por isso, valorizamos em diferentes ações e processos seletivos a participação de todos os diferentes perfis de candidatos e candidatas, nas diferentes dimensões de grupos que integram a agenda de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão.

O processo seletivo para esta posição segue o mesmo formato, etapas e formas de avaliação de outros programas de recrutamento da Vale.

Juntos, a gente transforma o futuro.

A Vale tem uma história de transformação. Na mineração, atuamos para transformar recursos naturais em prosperidade e desenvolvimento sustentável. Na segurança, buscamos aprender com o passado para evoluir diariamente e se tornar referência de confiabilidade.

Nossas pessoas fazem parte de toda esta jornada de transformação e evolução. Afinal, o nosso compromisso é com a vida. A Vale existe para melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro. Juntos.

Acreditamos que a mineração é essencial para o desenvolvimento do mundo e precisamos deixar um legado para o meio ambiente, para as comunidades em que estamos e para todas as vidas que tocamos.

Nos orgulhamos de empregar mais de 120 mil pessoas, em 30 países. Somente com esta força, nos tornamos a maior mineradora do mundo em minério de ferro, pelotas e níquel. Também atuamos nas áreas de logística, energia e siderurgia.

Quer conhecer nossa oportunidade?

Formação: Graduação Completa em Engenharia

Localidade: Nova Lima, Minas Gerais, Brasil

Horário de Trabalho: Diurno – Das 7:30 às 16:30

Período de inscrição: de 20/06/2023 a 26/06/2023

Como profissional, você vai...

  • Alavancar a cultura com implantação de melhorias para engenharia, confiabilidade, buscando aplicação de novas tecnologias para aumento da produtividade, sustentabilidade dos ativos e melhoria das condições operacionais;
  • Alavancar a confiabilidade operacional integrado com o time de Processos Operacionais de Mineração, Saúde de Usinas, visando alavancagem de UF, OEE e outros;
  • Entregar o programa orçamentário de custo referente ao Programa de Produtividade Ferrosos, atuando como sponsor e/ou líder técnico de squads para redução do custo de manutenção e produção;
  • Desdobrar, implantar e alavancar o processo de adequação e/ou revitalização de ativos utilizando como referência os Padrões Normativos Vale – PNRs;
  • Suportar e validar dos orçamentos operacionais (OPEX) e investimentos (CAPEX), referente as disciplinas que possuem correlação com Engenharia de Processos;
  • Desenvolver, disseminar e dar abrangência das estratégias e boas práticas para manutenção e operação;
  • Propiciar a otimização global dos ativos de usina aproveitando sinergias, ampliando a estratégias da cadeia produtiva e evoluindo os indicadores globais de processo e negócio;
  • Suportar tecnicamente em campo as operações referentes a soluções de engenharia, manutenção e operação;
  • Alavancar o programa Autônomos para Mineração (Mina e Usina), visando aumento de equipamento auto operadores, redução de headcount e redução de risco referente a segurança operacional;
  • Governar, otimizar, revisar e desdobrar dos Regulamentos Técnicos para Mineração e Pelotização;
  • Elaborar e implantar de iniciativas com foco em otimização Frota Ferrosos HME – Extensão da Vida Útil;
  • Atuar em iniciativas cross com demais áreas matriciais, com escopo em: Eficiência Energética Diesel e Eletricidade, Plano de Alavancagem de Especialistas, P&D Mineração, Agenda China e Alternativos.

Estamos muito felizes por ter alguém como você:

  • Graduação Completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em processos de mineração;
  • Conhecimentos em: confiabilidade, performance de ativos, performance de produção, custos e otimização de processos de manutenção e/ou operação;
  • Experiência em operações (vivência de campo em manutenção e/ou operação);
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e para acessar outros sites da empresa.

Como é trabalhar na Vale?

Para transformar o futuro temos de cuidar do presente. Apostamos em um ambiente cada vez mais aberto, em que as pessoas possam ser mais autônomas e buscar o seu desenvolvimento pessoal.

Criamos para os nossos colaboradores um portfólio de treinamentos e capacitações técnicas, de gestão e de liderança ou transversais. Acreditamos em quem faz a nossa empresa.

description:

Software Engineer - packaging - optimize Ubuntu Server for public clouds

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - packaging - optimize Ubuntu Server for public clouds role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
The Canonical Public Cloud team is looking for enthusiastic engineers to be Ubuntu distribution engineers. Engineers working on the Ubuntu distribution will work closely with the Ubuntu Engineering organization to ensure technologies such as cloud specific agents, webservers, databases, and virtualization and containerization stacks are optimized for public clouds. CPC works closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google, IBM, and Oracle and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users. Working on the CPC team as a distro engineer means working closely with partners and with Ubuntu to make the best version of Ubuntu for the cloud.
Ubuntu Server is a platform that enables amazing technology the whole world over, and is the #1 operating system in the public clouds. Applicants to this role will have the opportunity to help with everything that goes into evolving Ubuntu. The Public Cloud team builds Ubuntu Server for cloud environments, maintaining extensive continuous deployment operations to deliver images to end users. You will get to work with our experienced team and have the benefits of learning and growing alongside the best engineers in the business.
This role entails

  • Collaborating proactively within a distributed team
  • Fostering a software ecosystem with seamless user experience for all Ubuntu users
  • Evaluating contributions of other engineers to maintain high-quality software standards
  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu and Debian communities, with upstream projects, and commercially supported customers
  • Debugging issues on open source code and team maintained code
  • Working with the Ubuntu Engineering Server team to maintain and package software such as:
    • Cloud agents (google guest agent, ec2-hibinit-agent, walinuxagent, etc)
    • Traditional server workloads (web servers, databases, network services, etc)
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You value building partnerships with a diverse set of internal and external groups
  • Interest or experience in public cloud operations or architecture
  • Interest or experience in open source maintenance or contribution
  • Understands basic reproducibility and testing steps. Comfortable setting up test systems in containers or virtual machines. Able to describe issues and steps clearly
  • Strong fundamentals in Python
  • Interest in learning Linux distribution packaging
  • Fundamental understanding of package management and dependency resolution
  • Interest in containerization and virtualization such as Docker or OCI service containers, LXD system containers, and local virtualization like Virtualbox or QEMU, or Public Clouds
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Essa posição é para atuar em modelo híbrido.
Who will you be working with?
In this role, you will be working with our best-in-class IT Operations team, which drives operational excellence and continued automation in supporting business applications. This role will develop break-fix solutions and enhancements to reduce ticket volume and automate repeatable support tasks. This role will partner with key functional stakeholders, product team members, and support to develop deep technical domain expertise within the global operations applications.
How will you make a difference?
As a member of the Global IT Operations Support team, you will provide technical expertise leveraging the DevOps methodology, including Kubernetes, Docker, SDLC, CI/CD, Cloud, Microservice Design, and Monitoring. You will be responsible for supporting and developing business applications with the technical knowledge to do so. One of the main applications this role will be supporting is the Supply Chain Connect platform application, internally developed and used for managing sourcing, fulfillment, quality, and supply base interactive processes. This application includes several interfaces. This role serves as a technical domain expert for continued maintenance and support and will ensure data quality, ongoing break-fix development, and support automation for continual improvement.
What do we want to know about you?
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or “STEM” major (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Math) or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience as a Software Engineer or a Full-Stack Developer.
  • Experience in developing against HTML, CSS, Angular JS, Java, JBoss, Apache, Tomcat, J2EE, Springboot, Microservices, Restful Webservices, Postgres PL/SQL.
  • Experience with Linux, CI/CD, AWS, Terraform.
  • Experience with Informatica or Appworx, Swagger, and Postman or Akana.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver business needs on timeline.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Highly self-motivated, disciplined, and a team player.
  • Demonstrated experience in operations support.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.

What will your typical day look like?
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and problems for multiple applications in ServiceNow.
  • Facilitate outages with bridge calls, pull in required resources/skillsets, and communicate updates
  • Work along with the Support team to coordinate advanced troubleshooting techniques on critical, highly complex user problems
  • Resolve incidents and service requests for L3 level issues
  • Design, develop, test, communicate, and deploy break-fixes and prevent the recurrence of issues
  • Create change requests, implementation plans, and rollback plans for developed changes
  • Identify and execute on the development of automation opportunities to drive efficiencies in support
  • Understanding of best coding practices, adhering to all the software architectural and Security standards
  • Assist, guide, and troubleshoot with the Support team to resolve customer issues of a technical nature
  • Work with teams through Agile development practices
  • Conduct daily calls with the Support & Development team to drive faster resolution and escalate during SLA misses.
  • Drive KPI metrics for the applications in support and have weekly calls with Functional teams to showcase the metrics.
  • Perform user access and audit reviews for the applications.
  • Queue ticket management to ensure incidents are resolved on a priority basis.
  • Align to security controls, mitigate and resolve security risks, and complete security reviews.
  • Document standard operating procedures for issue resolution to provide to L1/L2 support resources
  • Collaborate with IT teams to ensure data quality of interfaces for data moving between systems
  • Facilitate deployment and release activities, including communication and additional support coverage
  • Develop and update chef scripts.

Who are we?
Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more! We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. Join to apply for the General Project Engineering (Project Design Team Lead) - Santa Barbara d'Oeste - SP role at Siemens Energy .

A Snapshot of Your Day

The role of Project Design Team Lead is to schedule and coordinate the scope of assigned projects that flow through the product design team. This position does not have direct reports but will lead various teams assigned per project requirements, including the coordination of daily activities.

Excellent collaboration and communication are critical to this role. This position offers growth opportunities beyond the core responsibilities, including interaction with the global Siemens-Energy TCP Organization and potential role expansion.

Our Transformation of Industry division focuses on decarbonizing the industrial sector through increased electrification and efficiency, supporting the transition to sustainable processes with a global presence and diverse technologies.

With ~100,000 employees worldwide, Siemens Energy develops future energy systems, ensuring reliable and sustainable energy supply, driving the energy transition, and fostering innovation rooted in a 150-year legacy.

Estamos buscando por Coordenador(a) de Engenharia Industrial para se juntar à nossa equipe de CNS SC Assembly & Fabrication em Sorocaba. Trabalhamos em estreita colaboração com partes interessadas internas/externas, como engenharia do produto, coordenação de contratos, planejamento e outras áreas relacionadas com a área de Consumables (CNS).
A cultura da nossa equipe gira em torno de cliente no centro, grande ambição - sempre, fazendo o que deve ser feito – juntos e abertos e sinceros.
Os membros da nossa equipe estão localizados em Sorocaba - SP

O que você fará

  1. Coordenar as operações da área da Engenharia Industrial, alinhando-as com as metas e estratégias definidas.
  2. Coordenar as atividades da equipe da qualidade nas definições de roteiros de inspeção, ações corretivas e controle da qualidade.

  6. Coordenar as atividades de abertura, controle e implementação dos investimentos da fábrica.

Quem é você

Graduação completa em engenharia mecânica, elétrica, produção, eletromecânica, tecnologia ou áreas afins;
Experiência profissional em gestão de pessoas, com desenvolvimento de estratégia, gestão de talentos e gestão de desempenho.
Mandatório experiência em conceitos e procedimentos de processos de fabricação (mecânica e soldagem), com implementação e execução.
Experiência com projetos de expansão fabril será um diferencial.
Conhecimento da metodologia Lean/Six Sigma - desejável.
Inglês avançado – mandatório.
Pacote Office avançado.

O que oferecemos

  • Um propósito inspirador – Possibilitar uma vida moderna sustentável. Minerais e metais são a espinha dorsal de funções essenciais no mundo moderno. No entanto, há uma necessidade de soluções mais sustentáveis para coletá-los e processá-los. Na Metso, você participa da transformação da indústria e de uma mudança positiva.
  • Ambiente de trabalho seguro – Para a Metso, segurança é um valor fundamental. Nosso objetivo é demonstrar liderança e visão na promoção da cultura de segurança.
  • Bem-estar – Nossos serviços de saúde ocupacional, associados às ações voltadas para a promoção de saúde e bem-estar, demonstram nossa preocupação com a qualidade de vida e engajamento das pessoas.
  • Remuneração e benefícios – Estrutura de remuneração e benefícios alinhada às práticas de mercado, oferecendo um pacote atrativo através de uma composição equilibrada que contém remuneração fixa e variável, além de assistência médica, odontológica, seguro de vida, previdência privada, alimentação, entre outros, segundo políticas vigentes.
  • Flexibilidade – Valorizamos interações presenciais e um ambiente de trabalho aberto e flexível, promovendo equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Uma cultura próspera – Estamos empenhados em desenvolver uma cultura inclusiva que permita a todos dar o seu melhor e atingir seu potencial. Uma cultura corajosa, convincente, atenciosa, que nos une para construir um futuro sustentável.
  • Extensas oportunidades de aprendizagem – Estimulamos diálogos contínuos, feedbacks, mobilidade interna, mentoria, treinamentos e desenvolvimento, além de projetos globais.
  • Interação sem fronteiras – Aproveite nossa rede global de colegas para troca de experiências e conhecimentos, com comunicação aberta e sincera.

Contato

Quer superar os limites conosco? Clique em “Inscrever-se” agora.

How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people

Metso é um empregador que promove igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido com uma cultura inclusiva e diversa. Todos os candidatos qualificados receberão consideração para emprego sem distinção de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, condição de veterano protegido ou deficiência.

A Metso é líder em tecnologias sustentáveis, soluções completas e serviços para as indústrias de agregados, processamento de minerais e refino de metais globalmente. Melhoramos a eficiência de energia e água de nossos clientes, aumentamos sua produtividade e reduzimos riscos ambientais com nossa expertise em produtos e serviços. Somos o parceiro para mudanças positivas.

Só no Brasil, a Ambev conta com mais de 30 cervejarias, maltarias e fábricas de refrigerantes, além de mais de 100 centros de distribuição direta e uma rede de quase 150 distribuidoras exclusivas. Isso sustenta uma das maiores e mais complexas operações logísticas do continente que não para de crescer, com decisões diárias que impactam milhares de clientes e consumidores. Trabalhar com logística na Ambev é atuar em alta escala, com dados, tecnologia e impacto direto no negócio. É oportunidade de fazer a diferença e crescer junto!

Atualmente a nossa Cultura passa por um processo de transformação e evolução. A nossa história e o nosso jeito de ser são marcados por sonhos grandes que nos trouxeram até aqui e que nos enchem de orgulho! Mas acreditamos que o momento de evoluir é sempre o agora e poder fazer isso junto com a nossa gente é o que torna nossa jornada ainda mais incrível.

Nossa cultura honra o passado e hoje também é norteada por 3 principais valores que nos guiam para sermos uma cia cada vez mais inclusiva, diversa, colaborativa, tecnológica e conectada ao futuro do mundo e da nossa plataforma de negócios, são eles: Escuta Ativa, Colaboração e Visão de Longo Prazo, cada um abarcando outras competências que fazem parte do nosso jeito de ser.

Nos orgulhamos da nossa capacidade de realização e paixão que nos trouxeram até aqui e para continuarmos a evoluir juntos te convidamos a fazer parte também dessa jornada.

Prazer, somos a Ambev e adoraríamos te ter com a gente. Vamos juntos?!

Aos candidatos internos: esta vaga pertence ao time Timeline | BSC SAZ BEES (Marketplace).


Main responsibilities

Você estará diretamente ligado à inteligência da operação logística, influenciando indicadores críticos. Participará de reuniões estratégicas com áreas comerciais e operacionais, tendo visibilidade e influência no negócio. Estará inserido em um time de alta performance, com oportunidade de aprender com especialistas, desenvolver visão estratégica e crescer junto com o negócio.

A rotina do cargo inclui:

  • Analisar as necessidades de compras e transferências com base na projeção de estoques e nas premissas de ressuprimento;
  • Identificar e corrigir inconsistências nas informações, garantindo a construção de planos de abastecimento mais assertivos;
  • Incluir e validar os planos nos sistemas SAP, Promax / Cora e Onplace;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos planos e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos KPIs de gestão de estoques;
  • Elaborar materiais e participar ativamente das reuniões de rotina com os times de logística das GEOs, comercial AC e campo, apoiando na criação e acompanhamento dos planos de ação.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos :

Formação : Superior completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos técnicos :

  • Domínio na área logística de planejamento de demanda e gestão de estoques
  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP (especialmente SAP), além de Promax/Cora e Onplace
  • Excel para análises complexas, relatórios e elaboração de materiais de apresentação
  • Noções de indicadores logísticos (KPIs) e melhoria contínua (PDCA ou similares)
  • Inglês será um diferencial, afinal estamos cada vez mais conectados aos times e operações de outros países

Habilidades comportamentais :

  • Raciocínio lógico e analítico
  • Organização e Planejamento
  • Visão sistêmica
  • Senso de dono
  • Capacidade de atuação colaborativa com times multifuncionais (logística, comercial e campo)
  • Boa comunicação para participar e conduzir reuniões de rotina
  • Atenção a detalhes e proatividade na identificação de inconsistências

Additional information

Hoje na AMBEV nós trabalhamos com os melhores benefícios para você e também para os seus dependentes legais! Aqui na companhia nós conseguimos te proporcionar:

  • Mais cuidado com a sua saúde através dePlano Médico, Odontológico, Telemedicina, Seguro de Vida e Gympass
  • Saúde mental com a Telemedicina Dasa e Gente 360
  • Consumir nossos produtos com um super desconto (é isso mesmo, nós temosvenda de produtos para funcionários no precinho! )
  • Reuniões de final de ano com a família ainda mais prazerosas, pois oferecemosCesta de Natal e ainda brinquedo para quem tem filhos
  • Proteção financeira com a nossaprevidência privada
  • A possibilidade de você fazer um bom mercado ou comer no restaurante que você gosta comVale Alimentação ou Refeição , pois você poderá optar por um destes benefícios
  • Ovale transporte é opcional e você pode conferir no modelo da vaga
  • Ter a oportunidade de receber um abono assiduidade, que nada mais é do que o14º salário para nossos colaboradores, um salário extra no ano!
  • Auxílio Creche ouAuxílio babá
  • Participação dos Lucros da companhia

Além de sonhar, se desenvolver, construir e crescer dentro de um ambiente meritocrático e inclusivo e ser capaz de fazer a diferença unindo as pessoas por um mundo melhor!

description:
Direct message the job poster from NTIATIVE IT Recruitment

Not your typical IT recruiter. Helping you find the best matching B2B & Perm IT roles.

Role Summary – Manager, Integrations Engineering (Contract)

Contract Type: DEEL-based, 12-month contract with potential extension or conversion

Reports to: Kevin (Technology Leadership)

Team Size: Initially managing a team of 3 (expanding)

Seniority Level: Leadership — not a hands-on software engineer, but must understand software/system architecture

Status: Newly defined role — previously had the title, but this is the first time the role has this scope

Mission of the Role

  • iPaaS platform selection and implementation (e.g. Workato, Informatica, Boomi – TBD)
  • Designing and delivering integrations between critical enterprise systems (Salesforce, financial tools, HRIS, and custom apps)
  • Establishing Agile, scalable ways of working across the integration layer
  • Mentoring and managing a globally distributed team

Scope of Responsibility

Strategic Design & Execution

  • Lead the technical and functional design of a new iPaaS-driven integration architecture
  • Define integration patterns, system flows, and documentation standards
  • Transition legacy or custom-built integrations to a standardized, scalable iPaaS model

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Finance, HR, and Insurance Ops
  • Understand and translate business goals into integration strategies
  • Collaborate on Salesforce CI/CD and integration workflows
  • Build and manage a distributed team of integration engineers
  • Lead performance management, hiring, and coaching
  • Drive a culture of agility, service ownership, and business-focused delivery

Target Candidate Profile

Must-Haves

  • Experience implementing or working heavily with iPaaS platforms
  • Previous people leadership experience (min. 2 years), ideally leading integration or platform teams
  • Hands-on understanding of integration design patterns, even if not writing code day-to-day
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Intacct, Workday, Netsuite, ServiceNow
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills — especially with U.S.-based counterparts
  • Experience in Agile or product-led environments
  • Track record of driving business outcomes through integrations

Bonus/Preferred

  • Background in IT systems leadership (vs. traditional software engineering management)
  • Experience selecting or evaluating vendors in the iPaaS space
  • Familiarity with performance metrics and KPIs for system health and team delivery
  • Cross-cultural experience (e.g. leading remote teams in LATAM, EMEA)
  • Depth in business impact thinking — able to articulate integration value beyond technical success
  • Role can be based in either Argentina or Romania
  • Initial preference may lean toward Argentina (due to existing contractors), but there’s more confidence and comfort starting in Romania
  • Decision may depend on talent density and ability to attract senior ICs in the chosen region
  • Comparative build-out strategy: Pie may begin hiring in both markets to evaluate quality and velocity
  • Contract model: Through DEEL, 12-month term
  • Compensation: No fixed band yet; will vary by region — comp should not be a blocker
  • Goal: Eventually convert to FTE or extend contract based on performance and fit

Interview Mindset

  • No binary "right or wrong" thinking
  • Looking for collaborative, thoughtful leadership
  • Evaluating candidates based on:
  • How they think through integration architecture and delivery
  • How they handle failure, ambiguity, and human dynamics
  • Ability to connect engineering outcomes to business value

title: Ação policial em Alagoinhas apreende veículo clonado e prende suspeito armado
description:
Ação policial em Alagoinhas apreende veículo clonado e prende suspeito armado

Policiais do 4° BPM, em operação conjunta com o CICOM, prendem suspeito em flagrante com drogas e arma de fogo

Por: Redação

Compartilhe:

Foto: Divulgação/Quarto Batalhão

Na noite deste sábado (28), policiais do 4° Batalhão de Polícia Militar (BPM), durante a execução da Operação Falcão, foram acionados pelo Centro Integrado de Comunicações (CICOM) para verificar a denúncia de um veículo clonado identificado por câmeras de monitoramento na cidade de Alagoinhas. A guarnição iniciou buscas para localizar o Volkswagen Fox de cor preta, e, após algumas rondas, localizou o veículo na praça do Condomínio Linha Verde.

Durante a abordagem, a polícia realizou uma busca pessoal no condutor e também no veículo, encontrando diversos materiais ilícitos. Foram apreendidos um revólver calibre .28 com seis munições, uma porção de substância análoga à cocaína, três trouxinhas de substância análoga à maconha, além de uma ferramenta geralmente utilizada em arrombamentos de veículos.

Suspeito preso em flagrante é apresentado à Delegacia Territorial de Alagoinhas

Diante das evidências, o suspeito foi detido e, juntamente com o material apreendido e o veículo de placa clonada, conduzido à Delegacia Territorial de Alagoinhas. No local, foi lavrado o Auto de Prisão em Flagrante Delito, reforçando o sucesso da operação em combater o crime na região.

A operação segue como parte dos esforços contínuos da Polícia Militar da Bahia para garantir a segurança e a tranquilidade da população de Alagoinhas, intensificando o monitoramento e a repressão ao crime organizado.

* O conteúdo de cada comentário é de responsabilidade de quem realizá-lo. Nos reservamos ao direito de reprovar ou eliminar comentários em desacordo com o propósito do site ou que contenham palavras ofensivas. 500 caracteres restantes. Comentar

Alagoinhas é um município brasileiro do estado da Bahia, localizado no Agreste deste estado. Sua área é de 718,089 quilômetros quadrados e sua população em 2020 era de 152 327 habitantes, tendo portanto uma densidade demográfica de 210,05 habitantes por quilômetro quadrado

title: Senior Graphic Designer, BR
description:
The Opportunity:

Are you a creative designer with a keen eye for detail and a genuine interest in diving deeper into the gaming industry? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, team-focused environment where you can expand your design expertise and make a meaningful impact? If so, you could be a great fit for the Senior Graphic Designer, BR role we currently have available at Team Liquid.

As a Senior Graphic Designer, BR , you will play an important role in shaping the creative direction at Team Liquid. This position involves developing, managing, and executing high-impact visual assets across multiple platforms. A core aspect of this role is encouraging a feedback-focused environment, ensuring design consistency, and guiding junior designers. You will contribute to the evolution of design systems, while working closely with internal teams, including marketing and content.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop and execute high-impact visual concepts and campaigns across multiple platforms, from ideation to final delivery.
  • Ensure all designs align with Team Liquid's visual identity and brand guidelines. Create innovative assets in both static and motion that elevate brand storytelling and impact.
  • Maintain and evolve Team Liquid's brand guidelines, ensuring consistency across all creative outputs.
  • Help update design systems, including branding and style guides, to guide scalability.
  • Contribute to refining design systems, including but not limited to brand and motion design to enhance visual storytelling.
  • Experiment with new tools, techniques, and trends to push creative boundaries.
  • Work with marketing, content, and creative teams to align design work with broader strategic goals.
  • Act as a design stakeholder in various campaigns, working closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Guide and mentor junior designers, offering constructive feedback and assisting with their growth. Conduct design reviews, offering direction and mentorship to junior designers.
  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring all timelines, deliverables, and quality standards are met.
  • Oversee the project lifecycle from conceptualization to execution, handling all aspects of design.
  • Identify areas for improvement in creative workflows, tools, and techniques to optimize design output and efficiency.
  • Introduce innovative approaches to creative processes to enhance continuous improvement.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of experience using Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Figma, and motion graphics.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Extensive knowledge of design concepts, typography, and photo retouching.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Proven experience guiding junior designers through the creative process.
  • In-depth knowledge of current design trends, especially in esports, gaming, and the entertainment industry.
  • Fluent in English.

You'll Earn Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Interest in gaining deeper insights into esports and gaming culture, and alignment with Team Liquid’s brand.
  • Interest in Web3 and related technologies.
  • Experience with UI/UX design and 3D modeling.
  • Proficiency in Blender, Cinema4D, or similar tools for creating 3D assets.
  • Awareness of digital item design trends (e.g., in-game skins).

This is a position with a PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) type of contract.

description:
Overview

We Are PepsiCo . Join PepsiCo and Dare for Better! We are the perfect place for curious people, thinkers, and change agents. From leadership to front lines, we're excited about the future and working together to make the world a better place.

Being part of PepsiCo means being part of one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with our iconic brands consumed more than a billion times a day in more than 200 countries.

In Brazil since 1953, PepsiCo has well-known brands such as QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI, among others.

A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world. Know more: PepsiCoJobs Join PepsiCo, dare for better.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

PepsiCo is a global food and beverage leader operating in more than 200 countries and territories with a product portfolio that includes 22 world-famous, billion-dollar brands. From Beverages to Snacks, we make hundreds of enjoyable foods and beverages that are loved throughout the world.

Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to be the global leader in convenient foods and beverages by Winning with Purpose. “Winning with Purpose” reflects our ambition to win sustainably in the marketplace and embed purpose into all aspects of the business.

You will be responsible for translating consumer needs into product requirements & technical parameters to launch delicious and nourishing products for CARICAM and South Cone. We are looking for a hands-on food product developer that has a passion for food science and is both, highly creative and technically oriented.

Our employees drive our culture. No two days are the same; we’re dynamic and full of passionate teams embracing new ideas through our collaborative spirit. At PepsiCo, what makes you unique, makes us better!

Its impact

  • Lead Innovation, TBS, Productivity and portfolio transformation agenda for grains category for CARICAM & South Cone and build the future of the platform to deliver growth and SOM through close working and partnership with R&D disciplines and business and SC teams to ensure a robust, safe and legal product design. Validate economic evaluations on ingredients, suppliers, and formulations.
  • Effectively manage multiple projects and project types, develop work streams, define resource needs, and drive alignment. Build and Track R&D budget.
  • Design and execute experiments. Analyze and interpret data to make sound technical recommendations on product and process issues.
  • Coordinate production at bench top, pilot plant, and manufacturing levels for shelf life, stability, sales samples, scale-up, and other needs. Guide Product formulations development that leverages expertise in food chemistry and food ingredient functionality.
  • The role involves managing priorities within direct team and across multiple commercial and business stakeholders leveraging expertise inside and outside the organization to deliver against commercial plans.
  • Support cross functional teams through Stage Gate process from Feasibility to Execution while ensuring a robust product & process design and support technical and business risk assessment/perspectives.
  • Project Management - Develop and execute complex projects utilizing technical project management tools and skills to ensure objectives are accomplished on time, to the agreed standards and within budget.
  • Clearly articulating and aligning technical development needs to influence the wider R&D organization to develop the correct future fit solutions.
  • Proactively challenging the suitability and performance of product designs to maintain a competitive advantage in terms of product acceptance, unique product design, cost of goods etc.
  • Heavy interaction and direct engagement with Contract Manufacturing & Ingredient Suppliers.
  • Actively participate in Marketing, Consumer Insights and Sensory and Consumer Experience Research to ensure data driven product design.
  • Proactively progress the Pep+ agenda from all aspects of our targets.
  • Support talent development by providing guidance and oversight to team members and maintain focus on people growth.
  • Represent R&D on multi-functional business teams comprised of individuals from a variety of disciplines, including Marketing, Purchasing, Engineering, and other groups.
  • Travel ~20%

Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?

  • BSc in food engineering, material science, food/dairy science, chemistry or other related disciplines; >5 years’ experience with a Company Packaged Goods company with min 3 years in Research and Development.
  • Deep knowledge of ingredient function, formulation, mass balances -Process development – Knowledge of grain-based products; oatmeal, ready to eat cereal, pancake mix, baked products.
  • Project Management – experience managing technical projects for several complexities, setting up the agenda and building timelines to meeting deadlines.
  • Strong working knowledge of experimental design & product development protocols (from concept to execution), including formulation, stability testing, product/package interaction, and sensory and consumer testing methodology.
  • Detail oriented scientist who can manage and partner across R&D functions during product development life cycles that include new idea generation, prototype development, product optimization, production start-up and national launching of new product.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, think with empathy, and goal oriented.
  • Proven analytical skills to interpret complex data and translate into meaningful information e.g. interpreting consumer insights, experimental design and statistical inference and ability to disseminate to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Influence others through strong communication & interpersonal skills and outstanding teamwork.
  • Demonstrated ability to function effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment as well as manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Adapts to change, flexible to work in a high-performance and ever-changing environment. Demonstrates personal leadership to influence and positively motivate self and peers.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and Knowledge management skills.
  • Self-starter, self-motivating: able to balance competing priorities without losing momentum and manage uncertainty and complexity in fast evolving FMCG environments.
  • Strive for high standards, seek innovative solutions, drive continuous improvement of products and processes and demonstrates a high degree of intellectual curiosity.
  • Passion for creativity and innovation within a commercially driven environment.

title: Senior Solution Engineer Post-Sales
